title: Uncowed Forces
statementMd:
Kevin Sun has just finished competing in Codeforces Round #334! The round was 120 minutes long and featured five problems with maximum point values of 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, and 2500, respectively. Despite the challenging tasks, Kevin was uncowed and bulldozed through all of them, distinguishing himself from the herd as the best cowmputer scientist in all of Bovinia. Kevin knows his submission time for each problem, the number of wrong submissions that he made on each problem, and his total numbers of successful and unsuccessful hacks. Because Codeforces scoring is complicated, Kevin wants you to write a program to compute his final score.

Codeforces scores are computed as follows: If the maximum point value of a problem is $*x*$, and Kevin submitted correctly at minute $*m*$ but made $*w*$ wrong submissions, then his score on that problem is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f09e285d608f9145474d19a6be3d314d100341d.png). His total score is equal to the sum of his scores for each problem. In addition, Kevin's total score gets increased by $100$ points for each successful hack, but gets decreased by $50$ points for each unsuccessful hack.

All arithmetic operations are performed with absolute precision and no rounding. It is guaranteed that Kevin's final score is an integer.

## Input

The first line of the input contains five space-separated integers $*m*_{1}$, $*m*_{2}$, $*m*_{3}$, $*m*_{4}$, $*m*_{5}$, where $*m*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *m*_{*i*} ≤ 119$) is the time of Kevin's last submission for problem $*i*$. His last submission is always correct and gets accepted.

The second line contains five space-separated integers $*w*_{1}$, $*w*_{2}$, $*w*_{3}$, $*w*_{4}$, $*w*_{5}$, where $*w*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10$) is Kevin's number of wrong submissions on problem $*i*$.

The last line contains two space-separated integers $*h*_{*s*}$ and $*h*_{*u*}$ ($0 ≤ *h*_{*s*}, *h*_{*u*} ≤ 20$), denoting the Kevin's numbers of successful and unsuccessful hacks, respectively.

## Output

Print a single integer, the value of Kevin's final score.

## Note

In the second sample, Kevin takes $119$ minutes on all of the problems. Therefore, he gets ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/42158dc2bc78cd21fa679530ae9ef8b9ea298d15.png) of the points on each problem. So his score from solving problems is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fdf392d8508500b57f8057ac0c4c892ab5f925a2.png). Adding in $10·100 = 1000$ points from hacks, his total score becomes $3930 + 1000 = 4930$.
statementZhMd:
Kevin Sun 刚刚结束了 Codeforces Round #334 的比赛！本场比赛时长为 120 分钟，共有五道题目，满分分别为 500、1000、1500、2000 和 2500 分。尽管题目颇具挑战，Kevin 仍毫不畏惧，一路势如破竹地解决了所有题目，在 Bovinia 的所有牛计算机科学家中脱颖而出，成为最优秀的牛计算机科学家。Kevin 知道自己每道题的提交时间、每道题的错误提交次数，以及自己成功 hack 和失败 hack 的总次数。由于 Codeforces 的计分方式比较复杂，Kevin 希望你编写一个程序计算他的最终得分。

Codeforces 的计分方式如下：如果某道题的满分为 $*x*$，Kevin 在第 $*m*$ 分钟提交正确，但此前有 $*w*$ 次错误提交，那么他在该题上的得分为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f09e285d608f9145474d19a6be3d314d100341d.png)。他的总分等于各道题得分之和。此外，每次成功 hack 会使 Kevin 的总分增加 $100$ 分，而每次失败 hack 会使总分减少 $50$ 分。

所有算术运算均以绝对精度进行，不进行四舍五入。保证 Kevin 的最终得分为整数。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含五个空格分隔的整数 $*m*_{1}$、$*m*_{2}$、$*m*_{3}$、$*m*_{4}$、$*m*_{5}$，其中 $*m*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *m*_{*i*} ≤ 119$）表示 Kevin 提交第 $*i*$ 道题的最后一次提交时间。Kevin 的最后一次提交总是正确的，并且会被接受。

第二行包含五个空格分隔的整数 $*w*_{1}$、$*w*_{2}$、$*w*_{3}$、$*w*_{4}$、$*w*_{5}$，其中 $*w*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10$）表示 Kevin 在第 $*i*$ 道题上的错误提交次数。

最后一行包含两个空格分隔的整数 $*h*_{*s*}$ 和 $*h*_{*u*}$（$0 ≤ *h*_{*s*}, *h*_{*u*} ≤ 20$），分别表示 Kevin 成功 hack 和失败 hack 的次数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即 Kevin 的最终得分。

## 说明

在第二个样例中，Kevin 解出每道题都花费了 $119$ 分钟。因此，他在每道题上都能获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/42158dc2bc78cd21fa679530ae9ef8b9ea298d15.png) 的分数。因此，他解题所得的总分为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fdf392d8508500b57f8057ac0c4c892ab5f925a2.png)。再加上 hack 获得的 $10·100 = 1000$ 分，他的总分为 $3930 + 1000 = 4930$。
